metas.name: Rocketry: The Nambi Effect
metas.description: The story of Indian Space Research Organization scientist Nambi Narayanan, who was framed for being a spy and arrested in 1994.

metas.name: Mahavatar Narsimha
metas.description: The demon Hiranyakashyap seeks revenge on Vishnu and declares himself a god. His son Prahlad remains devoted to Vishnu. Vishnu manifests as Narsimha to defeat the demon and restore balance.

metas.name: Meiyazhagan
metas.description: A man's life is changed when he bumps into someone from his hometown in this moving Tamil-language drama; gentle scenes are occasionally punctuated by sporting threat and recollections of violence.

metas.name: Mandaadi
metas.description: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

metas.name: Vikram
metas.description: A special investigator discovers a case of serial killings is not what it seems to be, and leading down this path is only going to end in a war between everyone involved.

metas.name: Maharaja
metas.description: A barber seeks vengeance after his home is burglarized, cryptically telling police his "lakshmi" has been taken, leaving them uncertain if it's a person or object. His quest to recover the elusive "lakshmi" unfolds.

metas.name: Amaran
metas.description: The life of Major Mukund Varadarajan and is set against the backdrop of the Qazipathri Operation in Shopian, Kashmir, which took place back in 2014.

metas.name: Tourist Family
metas.description: A quirky Sri Lankan family seeking a fresh start in India transforms a disconnected neighborhood into a vibrant community with their infectious love and kindness.

metas.name: Viduthalai: Part 1
metas.description: A police officer is recruited to capture the leader of a separatist group.

metas.name: Love Today
metas.description: Two young lovers, who are made to exchange their phones for a day and what happens due to that.

metas.name: Por Thozhil
metas.description: A bright but faint-hearted rookie cop has to overcome his fears in order to succeed in his first case which sees him partnered with a reclusive senior officer to catch a serial killer on the loose.

metas.name: Jigarthanda Double X
metas.description: In 1975, a filmmaker agrees to collaborate on a film with a gangster who wishes to become a famous actor.

metas.name: Thiruchitrambalam
metas.description: Thiruchitrambalam lives with his father and grandfather. He blames the former for the loss of his mother and sister and is not on good terms with the latter. Meanwhile, his love life is not so successful.

metas.name: Parking
metas.description: An elderly man and a youngster who are tenants sharing two different floors of an individual house fight over a parking space.

metas.name: Mahaan
metas.description: Gandhi Mahaan, a school teacher, is abandoned by his family after he decides to live a life of his own, with personal freedom.

metas.name: Jockey
metas.description: Rural action rooted in Madurai culture goat fighting tradition it blends fierce rivalries, raw emotions, trained animals, and authentic performances to capture the vibrant pulse of Tamil culture.

metas.name: Ponniyin Selvan: Part I
metas.description: Vandiyathevan crosses the Chola land to deliver a message from the Crown Prince Aditha Karikalan, while Kundavai attempts to establish political peace as vassals and petty chieftains plot against the throne.

metas.name: Viduthalai Part 2
metas.description: An unassuming school teacher faces extreme circumstances, forcing him to take up arms and lead a fiery rebellion against oppression, becoming an unlikely leader.

metas.name: Eleven
metas.description: A brave and skilled officer with a strong record of solving tough cases is assigned to a new, more challenging serial killing investigation.

metas.name: Maaveeran
metas.description: A cowardly cartoonist starts being 'controlled' by a cartoon action figure, and takes on a corrupt politician.

metas.name: Maareesan
metas.description: In an unusual situation , Velayudham sets out on a journey with Dhaya from Nagercoil to Tiruvannamalai-a journey that will alter both their lives in ways they never imagined. What unfolds becomes the heart of the story.

metas.name: Blast
metas.description: A seemingly ordinary family must unleash their hidden martial arts skills when they clash with a ruthless criminal gang tied to corruption and violence.

metas.name: Vaathi
metas.description: When a private school teacher is assigned to a neglected public school, he must overcome personal and political strife in his fight for education.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: Parthiban is a mild-mannered cafe owner who fends off a gang of murderous thugs and gains attention from a drug cartel claiming he was once a part of them.

metas.name: Jailer
metas.description: A retired jailer goes on a manhunt to find his son's killers. But the road leads him to a familiar, albeit a bit darker place. Can he emerge from this complex situation successfully?

metas.name: Ponniyin Selvan: Part Two
metas.description: Arulmozhi Varman continues on his journey to become Rajaraja I, the greatest ruler of the historic Chola empire of south India.

metas.name: Kaantha
metas.description: Set in the backdrop of a film set, in the 1950’s in post colonial Madras, the film is centred around the professional rivalry between a film-maker trying to make his seminal film and the top reigning actor who the director once introduced. The rivalry spirals around the leading actress, a debutante and as the relationship between the three.

metas.name: Captain Miller
metas.description: A man leaves and turns against the British-led Indian military after witnessing atrocity.
